_about: AB206 REALSIM aircraft data file. Every value names its source and confidence. Confidence levels: verified = from a primary certification document; derived = calculated from verified values with a stated assumption; secondary = published by a non-authoritative source, needs checking against your RFM; estimated = engineering estimate chosen to give plausible behaviour, NOT real aircraft data; tuning = simulation-only parameter with no real-world equivalent. Edit values here to match your aircraft (code G differences).
_variant: Bell 206B-3 JetRanger III with Allison/Rolls-Royce 250-C20J. User reports their 'code G' aircraft differs only slightly; differences not yet known.

rotor_rpm_100pct.source: EASA TCDS EASA.IM.R.512 Issue 4: 100% Nr = 394 rpm (to 3,000 lb); 395 rpm quoted for later sections

nr_power_off_min_pct.source: EASA TCDS EASA.IM.R.512 Issue 4: power-off 90-107% (355-422 rpm)

nr_power_on_min_pct.source: EASA TCDS EASA.IM.R.512 Issue 4: power-on 95-100% to 3,000 lb (97-100% from 3,000 to 3,200 lb)

takeoff_power_shp.source: EASA TCDS EASA.IM.R.512 Issue 4: 317 shp take-off (5 min) transmission limit

max_continuous_power_shp.source: EASA TCDS EASA.IM.R.512 Issue 4: 270 shp maximum continuous

max_gross_weight_kg.source: EASA TCDS EASA.IM.R.512 Issue 4 and CAA NZ AB206B report: 3,200 lb

torque_100pct_definition.source: Assumption: 100% torque = 317 shp at 100% rpm, so 270 shp max continuous = 85% torque. Matches the commonly published 206B-3 torque marking (85% continuous / 100% 5-min) but check your gauge markings

engine_rated_power_shp.source: 250-C20J/C20B take-off rating 420 shp (flugzeuginfo.net and engine literature). The airframe torque limit above governs

n1_idle_pct.source: Typical 250-C20 ground idle range ~59-65% N1; check your RFM

low_rpm_warning_pct.source: 206B-3 ROTOR LOW RPM light/horn commonly quoted at 90% Nr; check your RFM

vne_kias.source: 206B-3 Vne 130 KIAS sea level (secondary; varies with altitude/weight in the RFM)

tail_rotor_rpm_100pct.source: Commonly quoted 206B tail rotor speed; gives tip speed ~220 m/s

empty_weight_kg.source: Typical 206B-3 empty weight ~1,700 lb; individual aircraft vary

blade_count.source: Two-bladed teetering (semi-rigid) main rotor, all 206 variants

blade_lift_slope_per_rad.source: Typical value for NACA 0012-class blade sections

blade_cd0.source: Typical blade profile drag; tuned with induced factor for plausible hover power

induced_power_factor.source: Typical kappa for a two-bladed rotor

lock_number.source: Typical for a light helicopter; sets flapping lag 16/(gamma*Omega)

rotor_polar_inertia_kgm2.source: Blade mass data not public; estimated from ~40 kg blades plus tip weights. Sets autorotation rpm decay rate

collective_pitch_min_deg.source: Chosen so full-down collective autorotation holds Nr inside 90-107%

collective_pitch_max_deg.source: Gives hover at ~8 deg at max weight with margin

cyclic_long_range_deg.source: Rotor disc tilt per full cyclic deflection fore/aft

cyclic_rig_aft_deg.source: Swashplate rigging: centred cyclic tilts the disc aft relative to the forward-tilted mast, so hover needs near-centre cyclic

cyclic_rig_left_deg.source: Lateral swashplate rigging offset so hover needs only slight left cyclic against tail-rotor drift

cyclic_lat_range_deg.source: Rotor disc tilt per full lateral cyclic

mast_forward_tilt_deg.source: Forward shaft tilt, typical for the type

hub_height_above_cg_m.source: Overall height to hub ~2.9 m minus estimated CG height

mast_bumping_flap_deg.source: Teetering hub flap stop angle used for the mast-bumping warning

tail_rotor_arm_m.source: CG to tail rotor hub, from published overall dimensions

tail_rotor_height_m.source: Tail rotor hub height above CG

tail_pitch_full_left_deg.source: Full left pedal tail rotor pitch

tail_pitch_full_right_deg.source: Full right pedal tail rotor pitch

inertia_xx_kgm2.source: Roll inertia at ~1,200 kg, scaled with weight

fuselage_vertical_area_m2.source: Vertical drag area incl. rotor-wash download

hstab_incidence_deg.source: Inverted-camber stab producing down-force in cruise

vfin_incidence_deg.source: Cambered fin unloads the tail rotor in cruise

drivetrain_loss_kw.source: Transmission and accessory losses at 100% rpm

power_turbine_inertia_kgm2.source: Engine free turbine + drive shafts referred to rotor speed

skid_front_m.source: Skid contact point forward of CG

skid_rear_m.source: Skid contact point aft of CG

default_gross_weight_kg.source: Simulator default: two occupants, part fuel
